prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A print unit has a transport path for stock. The transport path defines a direction of transport. The print unit comprises at least two suction boxes, each having inlet openings which at least partially point in the direction of the transport path provided for the stock. The inlet openings of the at least two suction boxes together extend along an inlet length in a transverse direction, 80% of which corresponds to a working width of the print unit. The at least two suction boxes are arranged next to each other in the transverse direction and these at least two suction boxes can be removed from the print unit individually and independently of each other of the at least two suction boxes that are arranged next to the respective other of the at least two suction boxes in the transverse direction. The at least two suction boxes may each be connected to the same common suction line via flow connections.

outputs.L4:
A print unit is configured to transport sheet-like or web-like stock along a defined transport path. To hold and guide the stock reliably during transport, the print unit includes at least two suction boxes arranged adjacent to one another in a direction transverse to the transport path. Each suction box has one or more inlet openings through which air is drawn, thereby generating a suction force that acts on the stock. Collectively, the inlet openings of the suction boxes extend across at least 80% of the working width of the print unit, providing substantially uniform suction over a broad portion of the stock.

The suction boxes may be connected to a common suction line and supplied by a shared vacuum source. Despite this common connection, each suction box is mounted so that it can be removed independently of the other box or boxes. An individual suction box can therefore be accessed, cleaned, serviced, or replaced without requiring removal of the entire suction assembly. This arrangement combines wide and effective suction coverage with a modular construction that reduces maintenance effort, replacement time, and equipment downtime.
outputs.L5:
### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest and most frequently used words in the English language. Although it consists of only three letters, it plays an essential role in communication. As the definite article, “the” points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” may refer to any book, while “the book” identifies a particular one.

Beyond grammar, “the” creates a sense of importance and uniqueness. Expressions such as “the best day,” “the final decision,” or “the only answer” direct attention toward something definite and meaningful. Without this simple word, many sentences would sound unclear or incomplete.

“The” demonstrates how even the smallest elements of language can have a powerful influence. It helps organize our thoughts, clarify meaning, and connect speakers and readers through shared understanding.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style independent claim for a print unit having a stock transport path and multiple independently removable suction boxes arranged across the working width.
counterfactuals.output:
1. **A print unit comprising:**

a frame defining a stock transport path extending in a transport direction through a printing region, the stock transport path having a working width transverse to the transport direction;

a printing device arranged to print on stock conveyed along the stock transport path; and

a plurality of suction boxes disposed adjacent the stock transport path and distributed across the working width, each suction box having a suction surface facing the stock transport path and being connectable to a vacuum source to apply suction to the stock,

wherein each suction box is releasably mounted to the frame independently of the other suction boxes such that each suction box is removable from the print unit without removal of any other one of the suction boxes.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise technical disclosure for a print unit in which stock travels along a transport direction and is held by modular suction boxes whose combined inlet length equals 80% of the machine’s working width.
counterfactuals.output:
### Technical Disclosure

A print unit comprises a print station and a transport system configured to convey stock through the print station along a transport direction. The transport system includes a plurality of modular suction boxes arranged across a working width of the print unit. Each suction box has at least one suction inlet facing the stock and is selectively connectable to a vacuum source to hold the stock during transport.

Measured transverse to the transport direction, the aggregate length of the suction inlets of the installed suction boxes equals 80% of the machine’s working width. The modular construction permits individual suction boxes to be installed, removed, or replaced to adapt the suction distribution to different stock dimensions or printing conditions.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Create patent-claim wording for a modular suction system used along the transport path of printing stock, emphasizing transversely neighboring suction boxes, direction-facing inlet openings, independent serviceability, and common vacuum connections.
counterfactuals.output:
### Exemplary Claim Wording

1. **A modular suction system for guiding printing stock along a transport path in a printing or print-processing machine, the modular suction system comprising:**  
   a plurality of suction boxes arranged adjacent to one another in a transverse direction extending across the transport path;  
   each suction box having at least one suction inlet opening communicating with the transport path, the at least one suction inlet opening being oriented to face in a transport direction of the printing stock;  
   each suction box being mounted as an independently serviceable module such that the suction box is removable from, installable in, or accessible for servicing independently of at least one transversely adjacent suction box; and  
   a common vacuum connection arrangement fluidically connecting the plurality of suction boxes to a common vacuum source.

2. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, wherein the common vacuum connection arrangement comprises a vacuum manifold extending in the transverse direction and respective branch connections coupling the vacuum manifold to the suction boxes.

3. **The modular suction system of claim 2**, wherein each branch connection comprises a releasable coupling permitting disconnection of a respective suction box without disconnection or removal of another of the suction boxes.

4. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, wherein each suction box is individually secured to a support structure by a releasable fastening arrangement accessible from a service side of the modular suction system.

5. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, wherein the suction inlet openings of the plurality of suction boxes collectively define a suction region extending substantially across a width of the transport path.

6. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, wherein each suction box comprises a direction-facing wall oriented transverse to the transport direction, and wherein the at least one suction inlet opening is formed in the direction-facing wall.

7. **The modular suction system of claim 6**, wherein the direction-facing wall faces upstream relative to the transport direction.

8. **The modular suction system of claim 6**, wherein the direction-facing wall faces downstream relative to the transport direction.

9. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, further comprising an independently controllable valve associated with each suction box and configured to selectively establish or interrupt fluid communication between the respective suction box and the common vacuum source.

10. **The modular suction system of claim 1**, wherein the plurality of suction boxes have substantially identical interfaces for mechanical attachment and vacuum connection, thereby permitting interchange of the suction boxes among respective transverse mounting positions.

11. **A printing or print-processing machine comprising:**  
   a transport device configured to transport printing stock along a transport path; and  
   the modular suction system of claim 1 arranged adjacent to the transport path to apply suction to the printing stock.

12. **A method of servicing a modular suction system extending transversely across a transport path for printing stock, the method comprising:**  
   disconnecting a selected suction box from a common vacuum connection arrangement shared by a plurality of transversely neighboring suction boxes;  
   releasing the selected suction box from a support structure; and  
   removing or servicing the selected suction box while at least one transversely neighboring suction box remains mounted to the support structure and connected to the common vacuum connection arrangement.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
